_comment: CANONICAL list of Claude Code base models. Single source of truth for both
languages: Go embeds this file directly (claude_base_models.go), and a
consuming app can generate its own TS constants from it.
The Claude Code CLI has no list-models API, so these aliases ARE the provider
catalog. To add a model tier, edit ONLY this file.
Array order defines catalog order and picker sort order.
pinnedIds are exact CLI model ids offered alongside the moving alias.
